rows: Ad change log & impact – every change since Sep 1, re-scored daily

Each change is read again on every update: after 3 days, 7 days and 14 days (final). "Verdict history" shows how the verdict moved over time. Judged on CPI (FVV / 3VV / 5VV / Install) or cost per purchase (Purchase / RT). Impact is judged against the ad set's own trend over the same days, so a change is not blamed for a market-wide move. Pauses are judged on whether the paused ad was worse than its ad set and what the ad set did afterwards.
Adjust (purple): retention of the installs bought in the 3 days before vs days 1–3 after the change (blank until matured; ad changes = their ad set).
